comment: Serving set for the CUDA ComfyUI rental image. status: 'local' = exists on Liam's Mac at source_path (upload to R2 once), 'download' = must be fetched fresh (Civitai/HF), 'verify' = present locally but CUDA compatibility or exact workflow wiring unconfirmed.

artifacts.note: convrot int8mixed is a custom Comfy quant format — confirm the loader node works on CUDA. Fallback: quantize krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors (24G, local) to fp8_scaled on an NVIDIA box.
identity-reference variant used by the krea2_identity workflow

THE Krea2 text encoder (CLIPLoader type 'krea2', native in ComfyUI 0.29). Civitai model 2731465 version 3070870, bf16 file sha E6A3527E5CFC... — boxes pull it from Civitai directly; also local on the Mac. VAE is qwen_image_vae (Krea2 is Qwen-Image family, NOT flux2).

REQUIRED for the convrot quants: git clone https://github.com/BobJohnson24/ComfyUI-INT8-Fast (public repo, CUDA-native; local copy is unmodified). Loader node OTUNetLoaderW8A8, model_type 'krea2', enable_convrot=true. CUDA-VALIDATED 2026-07-31 on RTX 5090 (40s cold 1024², 8-step deis).

Required by the turbo workflow (strength 0.85, 8 steps cfg 1). In R2 since 2026-07-31. NOTE: the checkpoint loads via UNETLoader from diffusion_models/, encoder via CLIPLoader type 'stable_diffusion', latent via EmptyQwenImageLayeredLatentImage(layers=0). CUDA-VALIDATED 2026-07-31 (8s/image on 5090).
for the wai-anima-native-06b-hires workflow + /api/upscale fast path

minimax-h3-video.requires: Blackwell (sm_120) for the nvfp4 TE; ComfyUI >= e377e263 (2026-08-03, native MiniMax H3). Spectrum node: RES multistep 20 steps ~1.42x faster, final 3 steps always native. SYSTEM RAM >= 48GB or run ComfyUI with --disable-smart-memory: smart-memory retention holds TE (15.7G) + DiT (21G) in RAM simultaneously and a 31GB-RAM 5090 box thrashed to death mid-sample (validated the hard way 2026-08-04).

artifacts.note: Official H3 template DiT (pruned int8_convrot, loads via plain UNETLoader — convrot support is native in new ComfyUI). Relayed HF Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 -> R2 2026-08-04, inline SHA256 e889202c...5d03c47a.
Official template TE pairing (CLIPLoader type 'minimax'). nvfp4 needs Blackwell; the int8_convrot TE variant (27.1GB, on HF) is the fallback for Ada cards — not relayed yet.
Relayed 2026-08-04, SHA256-verified.
H3 generates video+stereo audio jointly; both VAEs decode from the same packed latent. Relayed 2026-08-04, SHA256-verified.

BETA minimax-h3-turbo workflow: larryvrh 4-step Turbo distill, drbaph ckpt500 pruned-ComfyUI conversion (HF drbaph/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora-ComfyUI, relayed 2026-08-06). MANDATORY MiniMaxH3SigmaShift video=12 audio=6 (wrong audio shift = broken audio); 8 steps, strength 1.0, res_multistep; no Spectrum at this step count.

git clone https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3 — Chebyshev spectral forecasting, ~30-34% sampling time cut on Euler/RES. Node SpectrumApplyMiniMaxH3 on the MODEL edge before guider+scheduler. Do NOT stack with EasyCache. Pinned-contract ComfyUI commit e377e263.
